pending_commit.commit_message: cryptohome: Fix chall-resp OAEP decoding failures Fix the incorrect construction of SecureBlob from a characters constant in the TPM 1.2 signature-sealing backend implementation. This CL makes sure that the SecureBlob is constructed from the intended 4-byte constant. Presumably, the old code was an undefined behavior due to creating a SecureBlob from a non-zero-terminated sequence of characters - i.e., effectively constructing std::string with reading some bytes beyond the global constant. For some reason, this bad code started to consistently fail starting from R77-12287.0.0 in official builders. As a consequence, broken from this point on the TPM 1.2 devices were the platform_CryptohomeTpmLiveTestServer Autotest, the hwsec.ChallengeResponseMount Tast test, and the actual challenge-response protected mount functionality (a.k.a. smart card based user login). BUG=b:135645781 TEST=On a TPM 1.2 device: test_that $IP platform_CryptohomeTpmLiveTestServer, tast run $IP hwsec.ChallengeResponseMount Change-Id: I44e02e8a7866a67e49670f81d4d6f7c9c54910a4 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1684332 Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>

runtime_probe: support native call to probe all categories via D-Bus call This CL adds implementation of native support to probe all categories via method ProbeCategories in the D-Bus interface.
